items.title: Hydroclimatic extremes shift GPP–ET response structures despite rising water-use efficiency in woody and herbaceous ecosystems on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau
items.title_en: Hydroclimatic extremes shift GPP–ET response structures despite rising water-use efficiency in woody and herbaceous ecosystems on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau
items.title_zh: 尽管青藏高原木本和草本生态系统的用水效率不断提高，但水文气候极端事件仍改变了总初级生产力（GPP）与蒸散量（ET）的响应模式
items.summary_en: Hydroclimatic extremes alter ecosystem carbon uptake and water loss, but their effects on water-use efficiency (WUE) are difficult to interpret because similar WUE changes can arise from different combinations of gross primary productivity (GPP) and evapotranspiration (ET). Using remote-sensing and reanalysis data, together with flux-tower evaluation at three herbaceous sites, we examined growing-season WUE trends during 2001–2024 and event-scale responses to extreme heat, cold, drought, and wet conditions across woody and herbaceous ecosystems on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. We decomposed long-term WUE trends, quantified joint GPP–ET responses, partitioned ET components, and evaluated hydrological modulation, response timing, post-event persistence, and background-climate breakpoints. Growing-season WUE showed positive trends across much of the vegetated plateau, predominantly because GPP increased faster than ET. However, positive WUE trends co-occurred with high event-scale sensitivity over 4.4% of woody and 22.7% of herbaceous pixels. Woody ecosystems more frequently exhibited same-sign GPP–ET responses, whereas herbaceous ecosystems showed more opposing-sign or weakly associated responses. Canopy transpiration was the largest individual ET component in woody ecosystems (48.7%), whereas soil evaporation dominated herbaceous ET (67.2%) and varied more strongly under drought and wet conditions. Ground thermal regime and shallow soil moisture further modified vegetation-type differences, although the effects varied among fluxes and extreme categories. Response timing and post-event persistence were distinct. Heat events were followed by sustained negative WUE anomalies, drought responses generally returned toward the pre-event reference within several months, and cold and wet events showed more temporally distributed trajectories. Continuous piecewise regressions identified a lower heat-related statistical breakpoint in herbaceous than woody ecosystems, whereas drought-related breakpoint differences remained uncertain because their confidence intervals overlapped. These results show that hydroclimatic extremes shift statistical GPP–ET response structures and that rising WUE does not necessarily indicate stronger carbon–water coupling, improved ecosystem functioning, or reduced sensitivity to hydroclimatic extremes.
items.summary_zh: 水文气候极端事件会改变生态系统的碳吸收和水分损失，但其对水分利用效率（WUE）的影响难以解释，因为总初级生产力（GPP）和蒸散量（ET）的不同组合可能会导致相似的水分利用效率变化。 本研究利用遥感和再分析数据，结合三个草本生态系统站点的气候通量塔观测结果， 我们考察了2001–2024年生长季的WUE趋势，以及青藏高原木本和草本生态系统对极端高温、低温、干旱和多雨条件的事件尺度响应。 我们对长期WUE趋势进行了分解，量化了GPP与ET的联合响应，划分了ET的各组成部分，并评估了水文调制作用、响应时序、事件后持续性以及背景气候的转折点。在青藏高原大部分有植被覆盖的区域，生长季WUE呈现正趋势，这主要是因为GPP的增长速度快于ET。 然而，在4.4%的木本像素和22.7%的草本像素中，正向WUE趋势与事件尺度上的高敏感性同时出现。木本生态系统更常表现出同号的GPP–ET响应，而草本生态系统则更多地呈现异号或弱相关响应。 冠层蒸腾是木本生态系统中最大的单项蒸散量组分（48.7%），而土壤蒸发在草本生态系统的蒸散量中占主导地位（67.2%），且在干旱和湿润条件下变化更为显著。 地表热状况和浅层土壤水分进一步加剧了植被类型的差异，尽管其影响在不同通量和极端事件类别中有所差异。响应时机和事件后的持续性也各不相同。热事件之后会出现持续的负水利用效率（WUE）异常；干旱响应通常在数月内恢复至事件前的参考水平；而寒冷和潮湿事件则呈现出更分散的时序轨迹。 连续分段回归分析表明，草本生态系统中与热事件相关的统计断点低于木本生态系统，而干旱……

items.title: Climate change and electrification could fundamentally alter grid planning paradigms
items.title_en: Climate change and electrification could fundamentally alter grid planning paradigms
items.title_zh: 气候变化和电力化可能会从根本上改变电网规划的范式
items.summary_en: Responding to climate change will qualitatively change electricity demand patterns, with increased peak sensitivity to temperature. Rising temperatures increase space cooling demand, and electrifying heat increases temperature-dependent, non-deferrable load while solar and battery resource availabilities are limited. Here, we present a first-order scoping analysis to characterize relationships between temperature and electricity load across the contiguous US to argue winter peaks pose a hard, underexplored design constraint. Specifically, residential heating electrification with efficient equipment could drive an estimated increase of 120%–200% (1000–1600 gigawatts, GW) in the sum of total peak loads (not necessarily coincident across balancing authorities), requiring at least 4.0–6.6 trillion USD of investment for generation and transmission infrastructure. By contrast, even 4 °C of warming would drive only a ∼41 GW (5%) increase. Deep building efficiency could improve energy and health equity, reduce challenging peaks, facilitate deep decarbonization, and save trillions of dollars.
items.summary_zh: 应对气候变化将从根本上改变电力需求模式，使峰值需求对温度的敏感度进一步提高。气温上升会增加室内制冷需求，而供暖电气化则会增加受温度影响且无法推迟的负荷，而太阳能和储能资源的可用性却十分有限。 本文通过一项一阶范围分析，描述了美国本土各州气温与电力负荷之间的关系，并论证冬季峰值负荷构成了一项严峻且尚未充分探讨的设计约束。具体而言，采用高效设备的住宅供暖电气化预计将使总峰值负荷增加120%–200% （1000–1600吉瓦，GW），这将导致各平衡机构（其峰值负荷未必完全重合）的总峰值负荷之和增加，需要至少4.0–6.6万亿美元的投资用于发电和输电基础设施建设。 相比之下，即使全球变暖4 °C，峰值负荷也仅会增加约41吉瓦（5%）。大幅提升建筑能效不仅能改善能源和健康公平性、缓解严峻的峰值负荷压力、促进深度脱碳，还能节省数万亿美元。

items.title: Atmosphere-driven compound extremes: record marine heatwave and phytoplankton bloom in the Ross Sea during summer 2022–2023
items.title_en: Atmosphere-driven compound extremes: record marine heatwave and phytoplankton bloom in the Ross Sea during summer 2022–2023
items.title_zh: 由大气驱动的复合极端事件：2022–2023年夏季罗斯海创纪录的海上热浪和浮游植物暴发
items.summary_en: We document an extreme marine heatwave (MHW) in the eastern Ross Sea during the 2022–2023 austral summer (DJF), the most intense thermal event in the satellite record. Using satellite-retrieved sea surface temperature (SST), ocean colour, sea ice, and atmospheric-oceanic reanalysis data, we show that the eastern Ross Sea experienced a Category IV (extreme) MHW during this season, with the regional-mean cumulative intensity reaching 127.22 °C·days in January 2023 and summer-mean SST anomalies locally peaking at approximately +2.5 °C above the climatological mean. Summer-mean chlorophyll-a (Chl-a) concentration reached 3.67 mg m−3, the highest value observed in the eastern Ross Sea since satellite ocean-colour records began in 1997. The ecological response followed a threshold-dependent sequence: early sea-ice retreat initially removed light limitation, followed later by a strong Chl-a increase as sustained warming and upper-ocean restratification favoured bloom development. In contrast, persistent ice cover in Terra Nova Bay prevented a comparable thermal or biological response. A meridional wind dipole drove divergent ice transport and the early expansion of the eastern Ross Sea polynya, while low-cloud cover decreased by up to 15.43%, increasing downward surface shortwave radiation by 64.09 W m−2. Subsurface warming remained confined to the upper continental-shelf waters south of approximately 73° S, suggesting that local atmosphere-ice-radiation interactions contributed more strongly to the event than heat transport associated with ocean circulation. These results identify a distinctly polar pathway through which atmospheric forcing can generate compound thermal and biological extremes, highlighting the importance of local sea-ice coupling in shaping future Antarctic coastal productivity.
items.summary_zh: 我们记录了2022–2023年南半球夏季（DJF）期间罗斯海东部发生的一次极端海洋热浪（MHW），这是卫星观测记录中强度最大的热浪事件。 通过利用卫星反演的海表温度（SST）、海洋颜色、海冰以及大气-海洋再分析数据，我们证明罗斯海东部在该季节经历了一场四级 （极端）海洋热浪，2023年1月该区域平均累积强度达到127.22 °C·天，当地夏季平均海表温度异常值峰值较气候学平均值高出约+2.5 °C。 夏季平均叶绿素a（Chl-a）浓度达到3.67 mg m−3，这是自1997年卫星海洋颜色记录开始以来，罗斯海东部观测到的最高值。 生态响应遵循了一系列阈值依赖的序列：早期的海冰退缩最初消除了光照限制，随后随着持续变暖和上层海洋重新分层促进了浮游植物的生长，叶绿素a浓度随之大幅上升。相比之下，特拉诺瓦湾（Terra Nova Bay）持续存在的海冰覆盖阻碍了类似的热力或生物响应。 子午向风偶极子驱动了海冰的发散输送以及罗斯海东部冰孔的早期扩张，而低云覆盖率减少了高达15.43%，使向下的海表短波辐射增加了64.09 W m⁻²。 次表层变暖仍局限于南纬约73°以南的大陆架上层水域，这表明与海洋环流相关的热输送相比，当地大气-海冰-辐射相互作用对该事件的影响更为显著。 这些结果揭示了一条鲜明的极地路径，通过该路径，大气强迫可引发复合性的热极值和生物极值，从而凸显了局部海冰耦合在塑造未来南极沿海生产力方面的关键作用。

items.title: Equity-centered dietary transitions: food-related GHG emissions and climate target alignment
items.title_en: Equity-centered dietary transitions: food-related GHG emissions and climate target alignment
items.title_zh: 以公平为核心的膳食转型：与食品相关的温室气体排放及与气候目标的一致性
items.summary_en: Global dietary transitions confront the dual challenge of reconciling nutrition equity with environmental sustainability. This study evaluates three equity-centered dietary transitions scenarios grounded in country-specific dietary recommendations across 181 countries: CP (current patterns), LP (low-emission substitutions, e.g. poultry replacing ruminants), and HP (high-emission alternatives), to quantify emission dynamics and assess alignment with Paris Agreement temperature targets. Business-as-usual trends (BAU) result in cumulative food-related emissions of 1768 Gt CO2e between 2020 and 2100. While CP reduces this to 1411 Gt CO2e, achieving only marginal alignment with the 2 °C limit, LP achieves a 37% reduction to 1113 Gt CO2e, ensuring robust compatibility with the 2 °C target. In contrast, HP emissions surpass even BAU levels. Central to the LP pathway, we propose an equity-centered allocation framework that differentiates mitigation obligations and emission allowances based on deviations from national dietary guidelines. Countries with excessive intakes, particularly of animal-source foods, are thus assigned stringent obligations (e.g. USA: 58.85 Gt CO2e; China: 131.10 Gt CO2e). Conversely, those with inadequate nutritional intake are allocated safeguarded allowances (e.g. Nigeria: 25.63 Gt CO2e; Ethiopia: 24.94 Gt CO2e), scaled to population size to uphold nutritional rights. However, even under this optimized pathway, the residual emission budget for non-food sectors is constrained to a narrow range of 407–818 Gt CO2e. This severe constraint renders the 1.5 °C target unattainable through dietary shifts alone, underscoring the imperative for coordinated cross-sectoral decarbonization integrated with equity-centered policies.
items.summary_zh: 全球饮食转型面临着在营养公平与环境可持续性之间寻求平衡的双重挑战。本研究基于181个国家的具体饮食建议，评估了三种以公平为核心的饮食转型情景： CP（当前模式）、LP（低排放替代方案，例如用家禽替代反刍动物）和HP（高排放替代方案），旨在量化排放动态并评估其与《巴黎协定》温度目标的一致性。 若维持现状（BAU），2020年至2100年间与食品相关的累计排放量将达到1768 Gt CO2e。 虽然“当前模式”（CP）将这一数值降至1411 Gt CO2e，但仅与2 °C限值略微一致；而“低排放替代方案”（LP）则实现了37%的减排，降至1113 Gt CO2e，确保了与2 °C目标的稳健兼容性。相比之下，“高排放替代方案”（HP）的排放量甚至超过了“维持现状”（BAU）水平。 作为“低排放”路径的核心，我们提出了一个以公平为中心的分配框架，该框架根据各国与国家膳食指南的偏差程度，差异化地分配减排义务和排放配额。因此，膳食摄入过量（特别是动物源性食物摄入过量）的国家将被赋予严格的减排义务（例如：美国：58.85 Gt CO₂e； 中国：131.10 Gt CO2e）。相反，营养摄入不足的国家将获得受保护的配额（例如：尼日利亚：25.63 Gt CO2e；埃塞俄比亚：24.94 Gt CO2e），配额规模根据人口数量调整，以保障营养权。 然而，即使在该优化路径下，非食品部门的剩余排放预算仍被限制在407–818 Gt CO2e的狭窄范围内。 这一严峻的限制意味着仅靠饮食结构调整无法实现1.5°C的目标，这凸显了必须开展跨部门协调脱碳行动，并将其与以公平为核心的政策相结合。
